import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/nlnet-csv-milestone')
station = root / 'station-csv-acceptance.json'
baseline = root / 'suite-evidence.json'
capture = json.loads(station.read_text())
suite = json.loads(baseline.read_text())
assert capture['all_pass'] is True
cases = capture['cases']
assert all(cases[name]['passed'] is True for name in ('clean', 'missing_required_column', 'extra_field'))
assert cases['clean']['issues'] == []
assert any(i['kind'] == 'missing_required_column' and i['header'] == 'reading' for i in cases['missing_required_column']['issues'])
assert any(i['kind'] == 'column_count' and i['record'] == 2 and i['expected'] == 2 and i['actual'] == 3 for i in cases['extra_field']['issues'])
assert suite['exit_code'] == 0 and 'passed 10/10' in suite['stdout']
result = {'purpose': 'Bind observed offline acceptance evidence for the proposed CSV milestone', 'sources': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (station, baseline)}, 'baseline': {'command': suite['command'], 'cwd': suite['cwd'], 'python': suite['python'], 'exit_code': suite['exit_code'], 'stdout': suite['stdout']}, 'observed_controls': cases, 'evidence_scope': 'Readback of saved synthetic execution evidence. Applicant eligibility, application, award, earned milestone payment and Treasury settlement require separate evidence.'}
output = root / 'milestone-acceptance-crosswalk.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
